release-manager: Heads up — scheduling a soft-launch for catalog model alpha-2026-03 tonight at 22:00 UTC. Traffic-hedge plan below, owners please ack if you own rollback/telemetry.

deploy-bot: schedule created for catalog/alpha-2026-03. Canary window 22:00 UTC -> 02:00 UTC. Preflight passed. CLI: `deployctl start catalog alpha-2026-03 --schedule 22:00 --mode mirror` :robot_face:

sam: quick Q — what's the fallback ordering if the quant variant spikes errors?

maria-eng: fallback ordering we want: 1) alpha-quant (regional) 2) alpha-base 3) stable-lumen-13b. We'll pin traffic back to stable if we trigger rollback.

kai: Telemetry/guards I'll add: auto-rollback if p95 latency +120ms vs baseline OR error rate >0.6% sustained for 10m. Also quality regression detected by A/B eval >2% triggers manual review.

ops-oncall: I'll own the rollback tonight. @release-manager ping me in DM if we need manual rollback, otherwise I'll let the automation take it.

deploy-bot: preflight details: model artifact checksum abc123def, infra capacity check passed. Plan: start in mirror-mode (copies only) for 30m, then enable serving in incremental steps: 2% -> 4% -> 6% -> 8% -> 10% with 30m pause between steps. Example command: `deployctl roll --canary 2 --step 2 --pause 30m --fallback-order alpha-quant,alpha-base,stable-lumen-13b`

sam: noted. There's a possible tokenization diff in alpha-quant seen in canary run earlier today. If it reappears, I have a small patch to toggle `token-normalize` off for the quant build. Will push pre-roll if needed.

maria-eng: added safety gate: any generation with length >1024 will auto-fail and route to fallback. Also uploaded smoke eval set to /evals/alpha-smoke and linked alerts: https://internal/evals/alpha-smoke.

kai: I'll mute noisy alerts and create an SRE CR for the perf thresholds so we don't page on expected transient noise.

release-manager: Final checklist: docs updated (internal doc link), release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/4512349999, change window 22:00-02:00 UTC, owners: ops-oncall, sam, maria-eng, kai. Please ack with :thumbsup:.

ops-oncall: acked. I'll be online 21:30-02:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: starting mirror at 22:00 UTC...
```
22:00:01 upload model alpha-2026-03 ok
22:00:15 start mirror traffic -> 10% copy
22:05:12 canary-arbiter: samples collected(1k)
```

sam: seeing initial perf bump in mirror logs — p95 +40ms vs baseline, within tolerance.

maria-eng: smoke eval passed, quality delta ~-0.5% (slightly better). No obvious regressions on the check prompts.

release-manager: rolling to 2% serving at 22:30 UTC. If no pagers within the 30m pause, we continue increments every 30m.

ops-oncall: oncall monitoring dashboard up, watching latency, error-rate, and token cost. Will call rollback if any auto guard trips. :eyes:
